settings.reduceMotionHint: State changes without animation (follows the system by default)

general.deleteBody: The VM is shut down and erased with its disks (/workspace included), along with the bots, conversations, memory and the keys kept in the system's password store. This cannot be undone.

providers.subtitle: Keys are kept in the system's password store. Each bot picks its provider and model.
providers.keySaved: key kept in the password store

secrets.note: Values stay in the system's password store. Variables reach the bots as environment variables; the others they only use by reference, without seeing the value. Bots can also ask for a password in the chat — the ones you send with “Remember” show up here.

vmWindow.pasteHint: Ctrl+V pastes text from this computer here

errors.no_qemu: qemu-img was not found. Install QEMU.

form.secretOn: Secret: kept in the password store, never shown
